an6.55:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati gijjhakūṭe pabbate.
an6.55:1.3: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā soṇo rājagahe viharati sītavanasmiṃ.
an6.55:1.4: atha kho āyasmato soṇassa rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi
an6.55:1.5: ye kho keci bhagavato sāvakā āraddhaviriyā viharanti ahaṃ tesaṃ aññataro
an6.55:1.6: atha ca pana me na anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuccati saṃvijjanti kho pana me kule bhogā sakkā bhoge ca bhuñjituṃ puññāni ca kātuṃ
an6.55:1.7: yannūnāhaṃ sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattitvā bhoge ca bhuñjeyyaṃ puññāni ca kareyyanti.
an6.55:2.1: atha kho bhagavā āyasmato soṇassa cetasā ceto parivitakkamaññāya seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya evameva kho gijjhakūṭe pabbate antarahito sītavane āyasmato soṇassa sammukhe pāturahosi
an6.55:2.3: āyasmāpi kho soṇo bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
an6.55:2.4: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ soṇaṃ bhagavā etadavoca
an6.55:3.1: nanu te soṇa rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi
an6.55:3.2: ye kho keci bhagavato sāvakā āraddhaviriyā viharanti ahaṃ tesaṃ aññataro
an6.55:3.3: atha ca pana me na anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuccati saṃvijjanti kho pana me kule bhogā sakkā bhoge ca bhuñjituṃ puññāni ca kātuṃ
an6.55:3.4: yannūnāhaṃ sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattitvā bhoge ca bhuñjeyyaṃ puññāni ca kareyyanti.
an6.55:4.2: kusalo tvaṃ pubbe āgārikabhūto vīṇāya tantissareti.
an6.55:4.4: taṃ kiṃ maññasi soṇa yadā ca te vīṇāya tantiyo accāyatā honti apinu te vīṇā tasmiṃ samaye saravatī vā hoti kammaññā vāti.
an6.55:5.1: taṃ kiṃ maññasi soṇa yadā te vīṇāya tantiyo atisithilā honti apinu te vīṇā tasmiṃ samaye saravatī vā hoti kammaññā vāti.
an6.55:6.1: yadā pana te soṇa vīṇāya tantiyo na accāyatā honti na atisithilā same guṇe patiṭṭhitā apinu te vīṇā tasmiṃ samaye saravatī vā hoti kammaññā vāti.
an6.55:7.1: evameva kho soṇa accāraddhaṃ viriyaṃ uddhaccāya saṃvattati atilīnaṃ viriyaṃ kosajjāya saṃvattati
an6.55:7.2: tasmā tiha tvaṃ soṇa viriyasamataṃ adhiṭṭhāhi indriyānañca samataṃ paṭivijjha tattha ca nimittaṃ gaṇhāhīti.
an6.55:7.3: evaṃ bhanteti kho āyasmā soṇo bhagavato paccassosi.
an6.55:7.4: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ soṇaṃ iminā ovādena ovaditvā seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya evameva kho sītavane antarahito gijjhakūṭe pabbate pāturahosi.
an6.55:8.1: atha kho āyasmā soṇo aparena samayena viriyasamataṃ adhiṭṭhāsi indriyānañca samataṃ paṭivijjhi tattha ca nimittaṃ aggahesi
an6.55:8.2: atha kho āyasmā soṇo eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto na cirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi
an6.55:8.3: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti abbhaññāsi
an6.55:8.4: aññataro ca pana āyasmā soṇo arahataṃ ahosi.
an6.55:9.1: atha kho āyasmato soṇassa arahattappattassa etadahosi
an6.55:9.2: yannūnāhaṃ yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkameyyaṃ upasaṅkamitvā bhagavato santike aññaṃ byākareyyanti
an6.55:9.3: atha kho āyasmā soṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā soṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an6.55:10.1: yo so bhante bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇāsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaññojano sammadaññā vimutto so chaṭṭhānāni adhimutto hoti
an6.55:10.2: nekkhammādhimutto hoti pavivekādhimutto hoti abyāpajjhādhimutto hoti taṇhakkhayādhimutto hoti upādānakkhayādhimutto hoti asammohādhimutto hoti.
an6.55:11.1: siyā kho pana bhante idhekaccassa āyasmato evamassa
an6.55:11.2: kevalaṃ saddhāmattakaṃ nūna ayamāyasmā nissāya nekkhammādhimuttoti.
an6.55:11.3: na kho panetaṃ bhante evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ
an6.55:11.4: khīṇāsavo bhante bhikkhu vusitavā katakaraṇīyo karaṇīyaṃ attano asamanupassanto katassa vā paticayaṃ khayā rāgassa vītarāgattā nekkhammādhimutto hoti khayā dosassa vītadosattā nekkhammādhimutto hoti khayā mohassa vītamohattā nekkhammādhimutto hoti
an6.55:12.1: siyā kho pana bhante idhekaccassa āyasmato evamassa
an6.55:12.3: na kho panetaṃ bhante evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ
an6.55:12.4: khīṇāsavo bhante bhikkhu vusitavā katakaraṇīyo karaṇīyaṃ attano asamanupassanto katassa vā paticayaṃ khayā rāgassa vītarāgattā pavivekādhimutto hoti khayā dosassa vītadosattā pavivekādhimutto hoti khayā mohassa vītamohattā pavivekādhimutto hoti
an6.55:13.1: siyā kho pana bhante idhekaccassa āyasmato evamassa
an6.55:13.2: sīlabbataparāmāsaṃ nūna ayamāyasmā sārato paccāgacchanto abyāpajjhādhimuttoti
an6.55:13.3: na kho panetaṃ bhante evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ
an6.55:13.4: khīṇāsavo bhante bhikkhu vusitavā katakaraṇīyo karaṇīyaṃ attano asamanupassanto katassa vā paticayaṃ khayā rāgassa vītarāgattā abyāpajjhādhimutto hoti khayā dosassa vītadosattā abyāpajjhādhimutto hoti khayā mohassa vītamohattā abyāpajjhādhimutto hoti …pe…

an6.55:15.1: khayā rāgassa vītarāgattā upādānakkhayādhimutto hoti khayā dosassa vītadosattā upādānakkhayādhimutto hoti khayā mohassa vītamohattā upādānakkhayādhimutto hoti
an6.55:16.1: khayā rāgassa vītarāgattā asammohādhimutto hoti khayā dosassa vītadosattā asammohādhimutto hoti khayā mohassa vītamohattā asammohādhimutto hoti
an6.55:17.1: evaṃ sammāvimuttacittassa bhante bhikkhuno bhūsā cepi cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā cakkhussa āpāthaṃ āgacchanti nevassa cittaṃ pariyādiyanti
an6.55:17.2: amissakatamevassa cittaṃ hoti ṭhitaṃ āneñjappattaṃ vayañcassānupassati
an6.55:17.7: manoviññeyyā dhammā āpāthaṃ āgacchanti nevassa cittaṃ pariyādiyanti
an6.55:17.8: amissakatamevassa cittaṃ hoti ṭhitaṃ āneñjappattaṃ vayañcassānupassati
an6.55:17.9: seyyathāpi bhante selo pabbato acchiddo asusiro ekaghano
an6.55:17.10: atha puratthimāya cepi disāya āgaccheyya bhūsā vātavuṭṭhi neva naṃ saṅkampeyya na sampakampeyya na sampavedheyya atha pacchimāya cepi disāya āgaccheyya bhūsā vātavuṭṭhi …pe…
an6.55:17.11: atha uttarāya cepi disāya āgaccheyya bhūsā vātavuṭṭhi
an6.55:17.12: atha dakkhiṇāya cepi disāya āgaccheyya bhūsā vātavuṭṭhi neva naṃ saṅkampeyya na sampakampeyya na sampavedheyya
an6.55:17.13: evameva kho bhante evaṃ sammāvimuttacittassa bhikkhuno bhūsā cepi cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā cakkhussa āpāthaṃ āgacchanti nevassa cittaṃ pariyādiyanti
an6.55:17.14: amissakatamevassa cittaṃ hoti ṭhitaṃ āneñjappattaṃ vayañcassānupassati
an6.55:17.19: manoviññeyyā dhammā manassa āpāthaṃ āgacchanti nevassa cittaṃ pariyādiyanti
an6.55:17.20: amissakatamevassa cittaṃ hoti ṭhitaṃ āneñjappattaṃ vayañcassānupassatīti.
